xEnglish: GCA / Go China Access is moving from concept pages to working product operations on Base.

Live today: controlled account access, read-only GCA wallet verification, eligible 100-credit and member ledger records, reviewed service requests, delivery receipts, and ten browser-only risk and research tools.
Manual boundaries remain: 30-day GCA Member approval, the 10,000 GCA member-benefit review, BaseScan profile publication, and any future trading integration.
Base Mainnet. Fixed supply. Verify the official contract and current feature status first.
xChinese: GCA / Go China Access 正在从概念页面推进到 Base 上可使用的产品运营流程。
目前已上线：受控账户入口、GCA 钱包只读验证、符合条件的 100 credits 和会员账本记录、人工审核服务申请、交付回执，以及 10 个浏览器端风险与研究工具。
仍需人工或外部处理：连续持有 30 天的 GCA Member 审核、10,000 GCA 会员权益审核、BaseScan 资料发布，以及未来任何交易集成。
Base Mainnet，固定供应。请先核对官方合约和当前功能状态。
